root.label: Coast Guard interception of Grace fuel ship

events.label: Coast Guard interception of Grace fuel ship

slots.name: ship length
slots.sentence: “Grace was transiting to Cuba, carrying fuel, and was believed to be employing tactics common amongst the dark fleet,” the Coast Guard said in a statement.

slots.name: interception date
slots.sentence: The vessel named Grace was stopped on 5 September in the Caribbean Sea between Cuba and Mexico while using tactics to evade authorities, the Coast Guard said.

slots.name: vessel length
slots.sentence: The New York Times reported that the ship was 91 metres (300ft) long.
